title: Is the Bible Reliable?
content: The Bible is considered historically reliable because of the large number of ancient manuscripts, early copies, and strong consistency across thousands of documents. The New Testament has more manuscript evidence than any other ancient work. Scholars compare manuscripts to verify accuracy, and despite minor copying variations, the central message of Scripture has remained consistent throughout history.

title: Was the Bible Changed?
keywords: did the bible change over time
content: There is no credible evidence that the core message of the Bible was changed or corrupted. While small variations exist among ancient manuscripts due to manual copying, these differences do not affect the central doctrines of Christianity. Modern Bible translations are produced by comparing thousands of early manuscripts to reconstruct the original text with high accuracy.

title: Who Created God?
content: According to the Bible, God was not created. God is eternal and has always existed. Everything that begins to exist requires a cause, but God is the uncaused Creator who exists outside of time, space, and matter. He is the source of all creation.

title: Problem of Suffering
content: The Bible teaches that suffering entered the world through human sin and the fall of creation. God created humans with free will, allowing real love and moral choice, but also the possibility of evil. While suffering exists now, God can bring good from difficult circumstances and promises ultimate justice and restoration in the future.
